git -c alias.ci='commit --no-verify' ci.reason: blocked: this git alias commits or pushes without the repo's git hooks, which skips the guard and checks. Fix what the hook reports instead.

git commit --no-verify -m x.reason: blocked: `git commit --no-verify` skips the repo's guard and checks. Fix what the hook reports instead.

git commit -n -m x.reason: blocked: `git commit -n` is --no-verify and skips the repo's guard and checks. Fix what the hook reports instead.

export GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS=\"'core.hoo.reason: blocked: setting core.hooksPath through GIT_CONFIG_* turns off the repo's git hooks and guard. Fix what the hook reports instead.

export HUSKY=0.reason: blocked: `export HUSKY=0` turns off the repo's git hooks for every later command. Fix what the hook reports instead.

git push --force origin main.reason: force-push rewrites shared history and cannot be undone for others. A human must approve it.

git push origin :old-branch.reason: this push deletes a remote branch or tag. A human must approve it.

git reset --hard HEAD~1.reason: `git reset --hard` discards uncommitted work permanently. A human must approve it.

git clean -fd.reason: `git clean -f` deletes untracked files permanently. A human must approve it.

git checkout ..reason: this discards local changes to every file permanently. A human must approve it.

git branch -D old.reason: `git branch -D` deletes a branch even when its commits are not merged anywhere, which can lose work. A human must approve it.

git branch -f main HEAD~1.reason: `git branch` with a force flag points an existing branch at other commits; its old commits are then reachable only through the reflog. A human must approve it.

git stash drop.reason: this deletes stashed work permanently. A human must approve it.

node .stack-agent/bin/guard.mjs --allow-.reason: `--allow-increase` raises the guard baseline and accepts new rule violations. A human must approve it.

chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit.reason: this changes the repo's local git hooks (.git/hooks). They are the gate that runs the guard before a commit, and a change there is in no diff. A human must approve it.

rm -rf .github/workflows.reason: this deletes the folder holding the Stack Agent CI workflow, the check that still holds when the hooks do not. A human must approve it.

echo x > .stack-agent/guard.config.json.reason: this changes the guard rules. That controls what the guard enforces, and loosening it is how a rule gets bypassed, so a human must approve it. To fix a violation, change the code instead. If you are filling in the template init just wrote (it still has EDIT ME and is not committed), use the Edit or Write tool instead: those do not ask for it.

echo x > .stack-agent/guard-baseline.jso.reason: this changes the guard baseline. That controls what the guard enforces, and loosening it is how a rule gets bypassed, so a human must approve it. To fix a violation, change the code instead.
